subject: Reasoning
description: Direction-sense problems: walking + turning, shortest distance, displacement

questions.stem: A man walks 5 km North, turns East and walks 12 km. His SHORTEST distance from start is:
questions.explanation: Shortest distance from start = √(5² + 12²) = √(25+144) = √169 = 13 km (Pythagoras: classic 5-12-13 triple). Distractor 17 = sum of legs. Distractor 11/15 = arbitrary.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Ravi walks 3 km East, then 4 km North, then 3 km West. His distance from starting point is:

options.option_text: 10 km, the sum of all walks
7 km, two of the walks added

questions.explanation: East 3 km, then North 4 km, then West 3 km — the East 3 and West 3 cancel out (he is back to original east-west position). Net displacement = 4 km North. Distractor 10 = total path length. Distractor 5 = ignored cancelling. Distractor 7 = wrong addition.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A boy walks 8 km North, then 6 km West, then 8 km South, then 14 km East. His final position from start is:
questions.explanation: N 8 + S 8 cancel (back to original N-S position). W 6 + E 14 → net 14 − 6 = 8 km East. So final = 8 km East of start. Distractor 6 = took only first west move. Distractor 8 West = sign error. Distractor 0 = assumed all cancel.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Facing North, A turns 90° clockwise, then 180° clockwise, then 45° anticlockwise. He is now facing:
questions.explanation: Start: N. +90° CW → E. +180° CW → W. −45° (anticlockwise) from W → SW (between W and S). Confirm: 0° = N, +90 = E, +180 from E → 270 (= W). −45 from W → 270−45 = 225° = SW. Distractor SE = went the wrong direction. Distractor NW/NE = miscalculated.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A walks 4 km South, turns left and walks 6 km, turns left and walks 4 km. He is now facing which direction?
questions.explanation: Facing S → walks 4 km S. Turns LEFT (when facing S, left is E) → walks 6 km E. Turns LEFT (when facing E, left is N) → walks 4 km N. So at the end he is FACING N. (His position: 6 km East of start.)
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Two cars start from the SAME POINT. Car A goes North 30 km; Car B goes East 40 km. The distance between them now is:
questions.explanation: Pythagoras: distance = √(30² + 40²) = √(900 + 1600) = √2500 = 50 km. (3-4-5 ratio scaled by 10.) Distractor 70 = sum. Distractor 10 = difference. Distractor 55 = arbitrary.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man starts walking East. He turns left, then right, then right, then left. The direction he is FINALLY facing is:
questions.explanation: E → left = N → right = E → right = S → left = E. Trace: facing E, turn left → N (90° left from E). From N, turn right → E. From E, turn right → S. From S, turn left → E. Final = E. Distractor S/W/N = errors at one of the turns.
